column1: # Exact line replacements the build bakes into this game's RomFS image (dm/tools/romfs_patch.py, applied by the
# NSP script after extraction, before the image's identity is taken): <path>
# the lines stripped of their indentation (the replacement keeps each line's own). The counts are of the stock
# file; a mismatch stops the build, so another version's files are never patched by this table.
# RunLogic.lua: the wide-screen fix -- UpdateConfigOptionCache's X/Y config options still read 1920x1080, so the
# two lookups are replaced by the literals of the phone's render size (2344x1080).
# HUDData.lua / TraitTrayData.lua: the HUD margin fix -- the absolute anchors move 40 out, so the wide frame's
# HUD sits at its edges (the bleed plates under ResourceBacking keep their stock offsets and are not listed).
# ObjectiveData.lua: the weapon tutorial objective sets (StaffTutorial, DaggerTutorial, SuitTutorial,
# TorchTutorial, AxeTutorial, LobTutorial and their aspect variants) each carry their own StartY of 45, the
# one value CreateObjectiveUI (ObjectiveLogic.lua) starts their rows from; at 45 the strip's first rows land
# under the top-left resource row the margin fix moved to the edge, so the strip moves 60 down to 105. No
# other objective set uses 45 (the rest fall back to the HUD screen's 150) and nothing else reads the value,
# so only the weapon move lists move.
